name: @fangpian/external-collab
_comment_studio: studio.previewChecks: Studio 在你声明完成时会打开真实预览逐条核对这些路由(不是你进程内的临时 server)。path 写关键页/接口的相对路径; nonEmpty:true 表示该接口必须返回真实非空数据(不是 200 空数组/全零)。请把首页与每个核心数据接口加进来(带真实查询参数), 这样'打开是空的'会在收尾前被自动挡回让你修, 而不是交付一个空壳。

scripts.ensure: [ -f node_modules/.bin/vite ] || pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile; { [ -f dist/main.js ] || [ -f dist/server/main.js ] || [ -f dist/server-build/server/main.js ]; } && [ -f dist/client/index.html ] || pnpm run build
scripts.start:dev: pnpm run ensure && concurrently -n web,srv -c green,blue --kill-others-on-fail "VITE_BUILD_WATCH=1 vite build --watch --mode production" "tsc-watch -p tsconfig.server.json --onSuccess 'node $(test -f dist/main.js && echo dist/main.js || test -f dist/server/main.js && echo dist/server/main.js || echo dist/server-build/server/main.js)'"
